dates_and_guards: Identical to parent method; training March 2-April 15, internal validation April 16-30, 389 s future and 600 s history guards
invalid_input_handling: Keep every original MM256 eligible window. An invalid auxiliary current value is replaced with the training-only median of valid anchor currents; its current_invalid_indicator is one. An invalid current or lag makes delta 0 and delta_invalid_indicator one. No future or bidirectional fill, no new gate. The 10% exploratory screen from F1 is not used.
learner: Identical StandardScaler and LogisticRegression(C=1.0,class_weight=balanced,max_iter=1000,random_state=20260926) to parent A
threshold_selection: Same 501 training-score quantiles plus always silent, maximize matched events within training false-new-alert budget, same parent ties; no validation threshold tuning
comparison: Same MM256 windows and event set for all three variants; compare internal-validation matched event counts with lead >=60 s, any lead, false new episodes and nonadjacent gate restarts. No significance or coke-plant transfer claim.
exploratory_stop_rule: If neither incremental variant gains at least one internal-validation >=60 s matched proxy event without increasing false new episodes relative to MM256-only at the same training budget, do not pursue additional B2 channels on this evidence; even a gain does not authorize selection/reserved-period repeated scoring.
selection_reserved_period: Do not open or score during G1 development experiment
interpretation: Post-F1 exploratory development extension after internal validation was already inspected; not an independent generalization estimate
